scope: Historical authoring-scope review retained for the 2 current-corpus extractions that were reviewed before later hash-bound QA acceptance.

method.procedure: Recompute source PDF, promoted production pages.json, production text.txt, and current QA-decision hashes; retain a historical prose scope only where its source quotes still validate against the promoted pages and the hash-bound repair plus QA adjudications independently confirm the affected and required pages. Record no new QA acceptance or release authority.
method.proseAllowanceMeaning: Only legible prose whose meaning does not depend on an excluded formula, plot geometry, table cell binding, or damaged symbol may be used for note authoring.
method.structuredAllowanceMeaning: false forbids treating the production text stream as a faithful structured transcription; a later source-visual transcription remains possible under a separate reviewed workflow.

restartSafety.staleIf: Any binding field changes, the QA decision is superseded, or the production extraction pointer changes.
restartSafety.resumeRule: Re-review only missing or stale entries, merge by paperId, and never propagate this scoped report into a QA acceptance or promotion decision.
restartSafety.bindingSetCanonicalization: UTF-8 lines sorted by paperId: paperId TAB sourcePdfSha256 TAB pagesSha256 TAB textSha256 LF
